---

### Input parameters

```{r input-variables}
GLOB_C <- "*nuclei_information_well*"
GLOB_S <- "*spots_locations_well*"
XY_RES <- 0.108  #Pixel size in um 
```

---

### Plate layout and experimental conditions

```{r}
#| label: read-metadata

light_levs <- c("Parental_1","Parental_2","Parental_3","Parental_Light_1","Parental_Light_2","Parental_Light_3","TetR#6_1","TetR#6_2","TetR#6_3","TetR#6_Light_1","TetR#6_Light_2","TetR#6_Light_3","TetR#2_1","TetR#2_2","TetR#2_3","TetR#2_Light_1","TetR#2_Light_2","TetR#2_Light_3","OptoTet#7_1","OptoTet#7_2","OptoTet#7_3","OptoTet#7_Light_1","OptoTet#7_Light_2","OptoTet#7_Light_3","OptoTet#11_1","OptoTet#11_2","OptoTet#11_3","OptoTet#11_Light_1","OptoTet#11_Light_2","OptoTet#11_Light_3","OptoTet#4_1","OptoTet#4_2","OptoTet#4_3","OptoTet#4_Light_1","OptoTet#4_Light_2","OptoTet#4_Light_3") 

plate_layout <- tibble(
  row = c(6L,6L,6L,6L,6L,6L,7L,7L,7L,7L,7L,7L,8L,8L,8L,8L,8L,8L,9L,9L,9L,9L,9L,9L,10L,10L,10L,10L,10L,10L,11L,11L,11L,11L,11L,11L),
  column = c(5L,6L,7L,18L,19L,20L,5L,6L,7L,18L,19L,20L,5L,6L,7L,18L,19L,20L,5L,6L,7L,18L,19L,20L,5L,6L,7L,18L,19L,20L,5L,6L,7L,18L,19L,20L),
  well_index = c("F5","F6","F7","F18","F19","F20","G5","G6","G7","G18","G19","G20","H5","H6","H7","H18","H19","H20","I5","I6","I7","I18","I19","I20","J5","J6","J7","J18","J19","J20","K5","K6","K7","K18","K19","K20"),
  light = c("Parental_1","Parental_2","Parental_3","Parental_Light_1","Parental_Light_2","Parental_Light_3","TetR#6_1","TetR#6_2","TetR#6_3","TetR#6_Light_1","TetR#6_Light_2","TetR#6_Light_3","TetR#2_1","TetR#2_2","TetR#2_3","TetR#2_Light_1","TetR#2_Light_2","TetR#2_Light_3","OptoTet#7_1","OptoTet#7_2","OptoTet#7_3","OptoTet#7_Light_1","OptoTet#7_Light_2","OptoTet#7_Light_3","OptoTet#11_1","OptoTet#11_2","OptoTet#11_3","OptoTet#11_Light_1","OptoTet#11_Light_2","OptoTet#11_Light_3","OptoTet#4_1","OptoTet#4_2","OptoTet#4_3","OptoTet#4_Light_1","OptoTet#4_Light_2","OptoTet#4_Light_3") 
) %>%
  mutate(light = factor(light, levels = light_levs))

```

---

### Download data in data folder if needed

```{r}
#| label: download
```

---

### Read cell data

```{r read-cells}
cell_tbl <- dir_info("data", recurse = TRUE, glob = GLOB_C) %>%
  filter(size > "1K") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(fread(path), file_name = as.character(path)) %>%
  mutate(well_index = paste0(LETTERS[row], column)) %>%
  select(file_name, column, row, well_index,
         field_index, time_point, cell_index,
         area, solidity) %>%
  left_join(plate_layout, by = c("well_index", "row", "column")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(light))
```

---

### Filter cells by size & shape

```{r filter-cells}
cell_filter_tbl <- cell_tbl %>%
  filter(area >= 60, solidity >= 0.95)
```

---

### Read RNA spot data 

```{r read-spots}
spots_tbl <- dir_info("data", recurse = TRUE, glob = GLOB_S) %>%
  filter(size > "1K") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(fread(path), file_name = as.character(path)) %>%
  mutate(well_index = paste0(LETTERS[row], column)) %>%
  select(file_name, column, row, well_index,
         field_index, time_point, cell_index,
         channel, integrated_intensity) %>%
  filter(cell_index != 0, channel == 4) %>%
  left_join(plate_layout, by = c("well_index", "row", "column")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(light))
```

---

### Filter RNA spots for filtered cells

```{r filter-spots}

filtered_spots_tbl <- spots_tbl %>%
  semi_join(cell_filter_tbl %>% select(well_index, column, row,
                                       field_index, time_point, cell_index),
            by = c("well_index", "column", "row",
                   "field_index", "time_point", "cell_index"))
```

---

### Count RNA spots per cell

```{r count-spots}
# Count spots per cell
spots_per_cell_tbl <- filtered_spots_tbl %>%
  group_by(well_index, light, column, row,
           field_index, time_point, cell_index) %>%
  summarise(n_spots = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Add 0s for cells with no spots
all_cells_tbl <- cell_filter_tbl %>%
  select(well_index, light, column, row,
         field_index, time_point, cell_index) %>%
  left_join(spots_per_cell_tbl, 
            by = c("well_index", "light", "column", "row",
                   "field_index", "time_point", "cell_index")) %>%
  mutate(n_spots = replace_na(n_spots, 0))

# Filter out cells with too many spots
all_cells_tbl <- all_cells_tbl %>%
  filter(n_spots <= 2)
```

---

### Summary table

```{r summary-table}

# Well-level summary
well_tbl <- all_cells_tbl %>%
  group_by(well_index, light) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    spots_per_cell = mean(n_spots),
    burst_fraction = mean(n_spots / 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    experimental_condition = sub("_[0-9]+$", "", light)
  )

# Condition-level summary
summary_tbl <- well_tbl %>%
  group_by(experimental_condition) %>%
  summarise(
    burst_fraction = mean(burst_fraction),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    norm_burst_fraction = burst_fraction / mean(burst_fraction)
  )

# Save summary table
write.csv(summary_tbl, "summary_tbl.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
